title: System ventilation efficiency.
officialText:
The system ventilation efficiency (E ) shall be determined using Table
v
403.3.2.3.2 or Appendix A of ASHRAE 62.1.
TABLE 403.3.2.3.2
SYSTEM VENTILATION EFFICIENCYa,b
Max (Zp) Ev
< 0.15 1
< 0.25 0.9
< 0.35 0.8
< 0.45 0.7
< 0.55 0.6
< 0.65 0.5
< 0.75 0.4
> 0.75 0.3
a. Max (Zp) is the largest value of Zp calculated using Equation 4-5 among all the zones served by the system.
b. Interpolating between table values shall be permitted.
